about: Queries an agent might send to `shadcn search @nitro-forge <query>`. Written before copy.json and before the baseline run, and not edited afterwards to fit the copy. `relevant` lists registry item ids; an empty list means no admitted item fits and the query is expected to fail. Items admitted: 17 (decision 2). Deferred adapters, engine packages and ignition are not registry items.
